name: claude-skills
description: Personal Claude Code skills, versioned in git so they stay in sync across machines and accounts.

plugins.name: codebase-teacher
plugins.description: Reverse-engineers an existing codebase read-only and writes a teaching handbook: architecture and flow diagrams, file-by-file explanations, Confirmed/Inferred/Unknown rationale labels, a file-coverage ledger checked by script, and build/test verification, built into a self-contained HTML (optional PDF). Plans on the session model, analyses subsystems on parallel Sonnet agents.

plugins.name: ebook-lecture-notes
plugins.description: Turn ebooks (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, MOBI, and more) into layered study notes written in the voice of a senior lecturer — named mental models, data-backed charts, a critical layer that argues against the book, and a self-test. Handles single books or a whole directory in batch.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Plan with the expensive model, execute with cheap parallel subagents. Produces a concrete plan using the session's active model (Opus/Fable), then fans the well-specified grunt work out to parallel Sonnet subagents to save tokens.

plugins.name: rnd
plugins.description: General-purpose R&D investigation pipeline for any domain — software systems, tools, frameworks, techniques, product features, infrastructure, or workflows. Researches a topic and produces a structured report.

plugins.name: skill-scout
plugins.description: Before a substantial task, finds existing agent skills that fit it, vets and security-reviews them, installs only the ones you approve, then continues the task.

plugins.name: smart-money-concepts
plugins.description: Knowledge base from two Smart Money Concepts (SMC) ebooks (Frank Miller 2024, and the anonymous E-book Smart Money SMC): market structure, BOS/CHoCH, inducement, liquidity sweeps, order blocks, FVG, POI, premium/discount, with testable algorithmic definitions and a book-comparison of where they disagree.

plugins.name: system-builder
plugins.description: Phase-gated workflow for building a new system end to end: kickoff interview, multi-agent R&D, detailed planning, subagent code execution, then review and demo. Pairs with the orchestrate plugin when installed.

plugins.name: trading-system-review
plugins.description: Fresh-eyes senior-trader review of an existing algorithmic trading system: re-runs the backtest, computes deflated Sharpe / PBO / Monte Carlo / regime stats with a bundled script, researches today's market and new techniques on the web (CloakBrowser fallback), scores a 10-dimension rubric with hard gates, and renders an offline HTML report with charts and a deploy / incubate / revamp / retire verdict. Delegates through the orchestrate skill.
